reason: A macOS computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness that exposes accessibility-tree inspection, screenshots, synthesized keyboard and mouse input, approval controls, and an MCP interface for desktop automation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 桌面操作插件，可读取应用辅助功能树和窗口截图，并通过审批控制合成键盘鼠标输入。
summaries.en: A macOS computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reads accessibility trees and window screenshots and performs approved synthesized keyboard and mouse input.

capabilities: Reads macOS accessibility trees and captures window screenshots
Synthesizes mouse and keyboard input on macOS
Exposes computer-use tools through a DeepSeek Harness plugin and MCP server
Requests macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions
Provides per-application approval policy and access status reporting
